name: SRSD Feynman Scientific Equation Discovery Benchmark
description: A benchmark for scientific equation discovery and symbolic regression, aimed at inferring compact mathematical expressions from data while incorporating domain knowledge. It evaluates models on their ability to search large hypothesis spaces and produce scientifically meaningful equations.
evaluation_method: Fit discovered equations to target data and score by prediction error, expression quality, and/or exactness against ground-truth equations.
